text:
Aisha Khan: Following the PM for the multi-region eviction spike. We need clear owners, Jira tickets, and a short RACI for each action. Trying to avoid the usual "who owns docs" shuffle.

ops-bot: Postmortem logged: PM-2026-multiregion-eviction (id: pm-2026-042)

Tom Nguyen: I'll pick up Action A: instrument per-region eviction metrics + dashboard. ETA 5 days. Will create the ticket and tag Carlos for infra access.

Carlos Reyes: @Tom noted. I'll provide the creds for the metrics queue and help wire up the dashboard. Can you include sample queries for 99th pct eviction latency?

Tom Nguyen: Yep, adding queries to the ticket. Created RINF-2520 "region-level eviction metrics + dashboard". Assigned to Tom. Reviewers: Lina, Carlos.

Lina Zhou: I'll take Action B: write the customer-impact matrix and suggested SLO thresholds for rollouts. Will need sample telemetry and recent incident window.

Aisha Khan: Lina, please include proposed customer comm templates for outage vs degraded performance. We should own the comms pathing.

Lina Zhou: Will do. Opening RINF-2521 "eviction impact matrix + comms templates". Assigning to Lina.

Carlos Reyes: Action C: infra remediation - add auto-evict backpressure and eviction-safe fallback into runtime. I can spearhead kernel-level changes but need a small design review and an acceptance test plan.

Tom Nguyen: For the fallback, can we prototype a fast-path that automatically switches to pinned smaller-window model variant? That could avoid noisy evictions.

Carlos Reyes: Good idea. I'll add that as a subtask in the ticket. Creating RINF-2522 "backpressure + fallback implementation". ETA 3w for prototype.

Aisha Khan: RACI proposal: Carlos = Responsible for backpressure/fallback, Tom = Responsible for metrics and dashboard, Lina = Responsible for impact + comms, Aisha = Accountable overall and will track CLOs. Informed: eng-oncall, product-support. Any objections?

Lina Zhou: Looks fine. Can we add a consulted role for runtime team on the fallback design (pinging @eng-runtime)?

Tom Nguyen: +1 to consulted eng-runtime. I'll add them as watchers in RINF-2522.

Jira Bot: Issues created: RINF-2520, RINF-2521, RINF-2522.

Aisha Khan: Action D: post-deploy canary that watches eviction delta and blocks rollout if eviction spike > 15% over baseline for 10m. Need owner for canary pipeline change.

Tom Nguyen: I can own the canary gating change in CI/CD. Will add acceptance criteria. Creating RINF-2523 "canary gating on eviction delta".

Carlos Reyes: For testing the gating, we need a reproducible eviction generator. I'll add that to RINF-2522 as an integration test.

Lina Zhou: For timelines, propose: metrics dashboard (RINF-2520) within 1 week, comms + impact (RINF-2521) within 1 week, backpressure prototype (RINF-2522) 3 weeks, canary gating (RINF-2523) 2 weeks. Is everyone comfortable?

Tom Nguyen: OK for my parts.

Carlos Reyes: 3 weeks for prototype is aggressive but doable. I'll flag blockers early.

Aisha Khan: I'll set a weekly check-in cadence. First sync Thu 9am PT next week. I'll create a recurring calendar and link tickets. Please update acceptance criteria in each Jira and add owners of subtasks.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync scheduled (2026-04-02 16:00 UTC)

Tom Nguyen: Added dashboard wireframes to RINF-2520.

Lina Zhou: Drafted comms templates and initial SLO numbers in RINF-2521. Need feedback by EOD Wed.

Carlos Reyes: Pushed prototype branch for backpressure into rinf/proto/evict-backpressure. Linked in RINF-2522.

Aisha Khan: Great momentum . If any ticket needs re-assignment or timeline slip, please @me. We'll close items only when runbook + tests + canary gates are in place.

Tom Nguyen: Will ping if infra needs extra quota for dashboards.

Lina Zhou: I'll circulate the comms drafts to product-support and legal for sign-off today.

Carlos Reyes: I'll schedule design review with eng-runtime for tomorrow.

Aisha Khan: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the canonical follow-up log.
